name: Kimai

short_desc: Kimai is a professional grade time-tracking application, free and open-source
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: APP_SECRET
form_fields.hint: Random string used for session encryption. Generate using e.g. openssl rand -hex 32.

form_fields.label: DATABASE_URL
form_fields.hint: Configure your database connection, see Application Setup instructions.

form_fields.label: TRUSTED_HOSTS
form_fields.hint: Domain or IP you will be using to access Kimai. Can be a regex like localhost|127.0.0.1|kimai.example.com

form_fields.label: TRUSTED_PROXIES
form_fields.hint: If behind a reverse proxy set this to its IP or network CIDR so that Kimai trusts its headers.
